overlay_format.position_rule: retain-base-indices; book0 membership; row-major valid coordinates

storage.scope: Explicit packed target-weight representation; base indices retained for support recovery. Non-target policy weights/biases, training/master states and torch.save container excluded. No runtime VRAM, compressed-resident kernel or latency inference.

inference_scope: Internal development cases; case-bootstrap intervals descriptive, not simultaneous or independent confirmation. No p-values or outlier removal.
claim_scope: Paired internal module-budget attribution diagnostic using reused calibration gradients. Untied increases storage/capacity; no new assignment method, independent held-out confirmation, ground-truth dynamics or closed-loop claim.
